interview.secured: A day is secured when you finish every task in the challenge that day, like walking 7,000 steps and posting your proof; the leaderboard counts these secured days since Monday.
interview.freeze: The app never clearly explained a freeze to me in what I saw, so I'm not sure; I'd only be guessing that it protects a streak if I miss a day.
interview.selfReported: I think it means the app takes my word that I did the task and doesn't verify it automatically, but that's from the 'What these words mean' screen's general idea and I can't recall a precise definition.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - I like the simple 7K steps challenge and the leaderboard gives me a bit of competition, but the unexplained terms and anonymous-looking names make it feel less personal.

goals.text: You joined a challenge in GRIIT on an earlier day and finished that day. Today you open the app again. Do whatever you think you need to do today, and look at your streak. Say in your thought what the app tells you about yesterday.
